nodes.summary: For a complex polynomial $Q$, this is the real number $\sup_{|z| = 1} |Q(z)|$, the supremum of $|Q(z)|$ over all $z \in \mathbb{C}$ with $|z| = 1$.
nodes.title: Sup norm of a polynomial on the unit circle

nodes.summary: An element of the class $S$ is a function $f : \mathbb{C} \to \mathbb{C}$ together with a sequence $(a_m)_{m \ge 0}$ of complex numbers such that $f$ is holomorphic and injective on the open unit disk $\mathbb{D}$ of all $z \in \mathbb{C}$ with $|z| < 1$, $f(0) = 0$, $f'(0) = 1$, $a_0 = 0$, $a_1 = 1$, and for every $z \in \mathbb{D}$ the series $\sum_{m \ge 0} a_m z^m$ is unconditionally summable with sum $f(z)$.
nodes.title: Normalized univalent functions with their Taylor coefficients

nodes.summary: For every $n \in \mathbb{N}$, every function $f(z) = \sum_{m \ge 0} a_m z^m$ of the class $S$ of normalized univalent functions on the unit disk, and every complex polynomial $P(z) = \sum_k p_k z^k$ of degree at most $n$,
nodes.title: Hadamard product circle bound for univalent functions

nodes.summary: The proposition that for every $n \in \mathbb{N}$, every function $f(z) = \sum_{m \ge 0} a_m z^m$ of the class $S$ of normalized univalent functions on the unit disk, and every complex polynomial $P(z) = \sum_k p_k z^k$ of degree at most $n$,
nodes.title: Statement of the Hadamard product circle bound

nodes.summary: For a sequence $(a_k)_{k \ge 0}$ of complex numbers, a complex polynomial $P(z) = \sum_k p_k z^k$ and $n \in \mathbb{N}$, this is the polynomial $\sum_{k=0}^{n} a_k p_k z^k$: the coefficient-wise (Hadamard) product of $P$ with the power series $\sum_k a_k z^k$, truncated at degree $n$.
nodes.title: Truncated Hadamard product with a polynomial

can_prove.label: ready to prove
can_prove.meaning: Statement is in Lean and nothing it needs is blocked, so the proof can start.

can_state.label: ready to state
can_state.meaning: Everything its statement uses is in Lean, so the statement can be written in Lean.

conditional.label: conditionally proved
conditional.meaning: Proof compiles, but rests on an open statement without a recorded Lean proof.

fully_proved.label: fully proved
fully_proved.meaning: Proved, and every prerequisite is fully proved too.

inventory_checked.label: inventory checked
inventory_checked.meaning: Module inventory checked in full; it records inspection, not a mathematical proof.

inventory_pending.label: inventory pending
inventory_pending.meaning: Module inventory not yet checked in full; it records inspection, not a mathematical proof.

not_ready.label: not ready
not_ready.meaning: Needs more blueprint work before it can be attempted.

proved.label: proved
proved.meaning: Proof compiles, but something it rests on is not finished.

stated.label: statement formalized
stated.meaning: Statement is in Lean; the proof is not.
